## Change and mathematical scope

**Scoped negative result; no new kappa.** On the frozen PR952 bit word, no allowed frame reassignment lowers its paid moment for any real `0 < c < 1`. Gate order and operands, start/final frames, and all nine COPY frames are fixed; frames range over spans generated by the live E8 lines. Cleanup frames are relaxed, so the result also covers the original H4 restriction.

The independent checker finds 314 free gates in 137 components. It covers 13,730 component assignments: 12,640 fail nesting, 1,090 are legal, and every legal assignment preserves the original COPY frames. Of 934 strict profile alternatives, 933 have integer concavity certificates and one exact exceptional profile has a separate monotonicity proof. Nineteen componentwise alternatives retain the baseline profile. The paid profile and current selected kappa are unchanged.

This extends @SethBurkart123's PR886 fixed-word question to Gareth Davidson's changed PR952 scalar circuit, with Ross Richardson's PR936 and PR904/589/555 ancestry credited. PR933's selected-word rewrite exclusions do not cover this changed scalar word. No general optimality over circuits, hosting, copies or ambient subspaces is claimed.

Exact base: `8bddbee377e2f3ce1f1247196c4b290d55767d20`. PR952 source head: `11d24706f06e95271804c9438869546724c67aab`. Assignment seed 10; complete source pins, local claim, overlap review, proof and certificates are in `research/r439-resynth-frame-seed10/`. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human review or formal proof of the multiplication theorem is claimed.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-resynth-frame-seed10/check.py
python3 -I -B research/r439-resynth-frame-seed10/test_package.py -v
python3 -I -B research/r439-resynth-frame-seed10/nominate.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R439_RESYNTH_FRAME_INDEPENDENT`, six package tests pass, and `PASS_R439_RESYNTH_NOMINATION free=314 assignments=13730 improving=0`.

The independent implementation uses exact integer row spaces, constrained enumeration and register-chain costs. It rejects nine mathematical controls and recovers the baseline from a degraded legal assignment through 77 improving components. Package controls cover missing domains/components, COPY changes, source corruption and optimized Python. The unchanged source checker passes all 661 dirty-input columns and H1-H5. Current T37 exact arithmetic and all 876 selected-source digests also pass.

Only this research package is added. `upstream/` and the selected frontier are unchanged. Full `make verify`, native multistage and selected cold replays were not repeated for this fixed-word negative result; their existing construction evidence and all inherited compiler/physical/hosting/precision/analytic assumptions remain. `VALIDATION.json` records the executed checks and limits.
